body.message:
Thank you for your support and for trying your best regarding the rate.

We would like to proceed with the extension.

If possible on your side, we would really appreciate paying the amount in 2 installments. We can pay AED 3,000 at the beginning, and the remaining balance after around 10 days, as we are currently waiting to receive payment from our client/partner, who is expected to complete the transfer next week.

Also, could you please share your bank account details with us? We would prefer to make the payment via bank transfer or cash payment in order to avoid the additional transaction fee.

Please let us know if this arrangement can be accommodated.

Thank you again.
